abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 8. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 186 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 180 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 270 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 109 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 109 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 142 | 450 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
